name: xbind-shell
about: the transcript of xbind-shell.json in the chat kit's block model (/vendor/chat/blocks.js) after each of its checkpoints — blocks; tail: what waits on a person beside them; plan: the key of the newest plan block; usage. A block's k is the seq of the event that opened it (the Agent tab's key); versions (v) and clock times (at) are left out, and a field at its zero value too.

blocks.text: run: echo hi > made.txt && sed -i 's/main() {}/main() { println(1) }/' main.go
